study: Short gap-down names for the day: stocks that open more than 1% below the prior close, shorted at the open and covered at the close.
registered_at: 2026-10-16 ~06:00 ET, before any data for this test was fetched or computed.
origin: Operator 10/16 asked for more options; candidate #1 from the desk's gap-down gate (ai_watch_gap_down_block_pct 1.0).
prior: LOW-MEDIUM and conflicted: in-sample 9/14-23 gap-downs >1% fell 1% before rising 1% more often (z -3.7); the out-of-sample grade 10/4 (42 refused name-days, 7 days) found them RISING into the close (+258 bp mean) - UNCONFIRMED. Short-horizon shorts of admitted (up) names were a coin flip with a squeeze tail (short-the-fade-has-no-edge).
data: Alpaca SIP daily bars (split/dividend adjusted where available) 2016-01-01 to 2026-10-15 for the current liquid universe: US common stock (ticker_filters.is_common, no ETFs/funds), price >= $10 and 20-day average dollar volume >= $20M on the PRIOR day. Survivorship: delisted names are missing; for shorts that omission is conservative (names that collapsed are absent) and is stated with the result.
signal: open(d) / close(d-1) - 1 <= -1.0% (the official SIP open). Name must also pass the liquidity rule on d-1. Both measured with information available at the open.
trade: short at open(d), cover at close(d); equal dollar weight per name per day; at most 20 names per day (largest gaps first) so a crash day cannot dominate.
cost: 10 bp round trip (open and close auctions on liquid names) plus 2 bp borrow for one day; also reported at 25 bp as a stress line.
statistic: daily portfolio return (mean of the day's names), net of cost; mean, day-clustered t, Sharpe (annualized), worst day, worst month, share of positive months; and the same short on a random set of NON-gap names the same day (same count, seeded) as the control.
pass: PASS only if, in BOTH halves: mean net daily return > 0 with t >= 2.0, above the random-short control with t >= 2.0, and >= 55% positive months. Otherwise FAIL (or UNDERPOWERED if fewer than 500 trading days with a signal per half).
information_only: hold to 10:30 and to 12:00 instead of the close (needs intraday bars: only if daily PASSES)
a SPY-hedged version (short gap-downs, long SPY equal dollars)
no_retuning: -1%, $10, $20M, 20 names, open-to-close and the cost are fixed; any other threshold is a new prereg.
if_pass: pre-register a paper forward test on the overnight/weekly account plumbing (market-on-open / market-on-close orders) for >= 30 sessions; result-skeptic review of the positive before any trading.
if_fail: the gap-down signal stays an avoid-filter only; record it as tested.

amended_1.at: 2026-10-16, after result-skeptic round 1 (NOT READY, findings 1-8), before any data was fetched.
amended_1.entry_timing: (#1) the signal uses the official open(d)/close(d-1) - 1 <= -1%, so entry CANNOT be the open. Short at the OPEN of the 09:31 one-minute SIP bar, cover at the official close(d). Minute bars are fetched only for the 09:31 bar, multi-symbol per day. Names with no 09:31 bar (halted or late open) are dropped and counted. Open-to-close is reported as information only.
amended_1.filters: (#2) the $10 price and $20M 20-day dollar-volume rules use RAW (unadjusted) prior-day closes and volumes. The gap and the returns use split- and dividend-adjusted bars (Alpaca adjustment=all), so an ex-dividend drop is not a gap (#7).
amended_1.universe: (#3) ACTIVE plus INACTIVE US common stock, through the allsym_daily_fetch.py asset listing. Tickers later reused by another company are still lost, and this is stated with the result. The pass rests on the gap-minus-control difference, not on the absolute mean.
amended_1.short_constraints: (#4) exclude gaps <= -10% and names that closed <= -10% on d-1 (Rule 201 SSR). Report the share of picks that are not easy-to-borrow at Alpaca today (information; historical borrow is unknowable). Borrow fee dropped (same-day cover); cost is 10 bp round trip, with a 25 bp stress line.
amended_1.control: (#5) deterministic: the equal-weight mean of ALL universe names with gaps in (-1%, +1%) that day, entered and exited the same way (09:31 open to close). No random seed.
amended_1.statistic: (#5) the paired per-day difference, short-gap minus short-control, net of cost, with a day-clustered t (one value per day). A SPY-hedged line (short gap names, long SPY equal dollars, both from the 09:31 open) is part of the pass bar.
amended_1.pass: PASS only if, in BOTH halves: (a) the paired difference > 0 with t >= 2.0; (b) the SPY-hedged short return > 0 with t >= 2.0; (c) net short return >= 55% positive months; (d) (a) still > 0 after dropping the top 3 days and the top 5 names by contribution in that half (#6). Otherwise FAIL. UNDERPOWERED if fewer than 500 signal days in a half.
amended_1.logging: (#8) log every symbol dropped for missing bars, 429s or failed fetches. A day with fewer than 300 universe names is excluded and counted.
amended_1.unchanged: -1% threshold, at most 20 names per day (largest gaps first, among names passing the SSR exclusion), $10, $20M, halves, if_pass and if_fail.

amended_2.at: 2026-10-16, after result-skeptic round 2 (NOT READY, 4 items), before any data was fetched. Fixes applied exactly as specified; no round 3.
amended_2.signal_timing: (r2 #1) signal = close of the 09:30 SIP one-minute bar / adjusted close(d-1) - 1 <= -1% (known at 09:31:00). Enter at the OPEN of the 09:31 bar, cover at the official close(d). Names with no 09:30 bar or no 09:31 bar are dropped and counted. The control band (-1%, +1%) and the SSR gap exclusion (<= -10%) use the same 09:30-close gap.
amended_2.adjustment: (r2 #2) daily bars AND the 09:30/09:31 minute bars use adjustment=all for the gap and returns. A separate RAW daily pull drives the $10 price and $20M dollar-volume filters. allsym_daily_fetch.py's split-only cache is NOT reused for returns.
amended_2.cost: (r2 #3) base cost is 20 bp round trip (09:31 market order plus close auction); 25 bp stress line. Pass legs (b) and (c) must hold at 25 bp.
amended_2.etf_exclusion: (r2 #4) exclude any asset whose Alpaca asset name matches ticker_filters.FUND_NAME / is_not_stock (ETF, Fund, Trust, ProShares, Direxion, iShares, etc.) on top of is_common; log the count excluded.
